_note: Single-source (Carthaginian, Punic Wars era). Punic/Phoenician sub-palette; a maritime trading people. civ = feudal (mercantile-oligarchy character is narrative flavor only). Even split Neutral/Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Punic register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Punic phonology (drop -us; v->b; f->p; sh/q/kh; feminine -t), never real Phoenician gods.

phonology.palette: Punic/Phoenician: b d g, ', sh, ts, q, kh; vowels a i o u; feminine -t; theophoric stems are morphed canon-names (Tulrish-, Arganz-, Numyo-, Orlanz-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC; gutturals and emphatics; construct chains (X-of-Y); stress final/penultimate.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic 'bin/ben' (son of); theophoric given names on morphed god-stems (abd-X = servant-of-X); house name for nobility.
morphology.compounding_rule: construct chain: feature/qart + -of-deity: Qart-Hadeshet (new city), Beth-Tulrish (house of Tulrish); resource + feature: Mahoz-Argaman (purple-port).

title_ladder.government: feudal (Punic; the historical merchant-oligarchy/suffete council is narrative flavor only)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Punic, ascending (barony..empire). Built on the mlk root: Melek/Mamlakat (king/kingdom), Adirmelek/Adirmamlakat (mighty-king / great-realm). Shophet (suffete/judge) survives as the county tier; march = Massar (warden). (Rank titles are the real Punic register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: given (often theophoric) + patronymic (bin-X) or house; merchants add a trade-byname.
people_name_convention.dual_register: nobles use a house name; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: given names built from the morphed deity-names + a Punic element: abd-X (servant-of), X-yaton (X-gave), bod-X (in-hand-of). e.g. Abd-Arganz, Numyo-yaton.

religion._note: Deity-names are phoneme-morphs of the canonical (Agrippan) pantheon through Punic phonology — recognizably the same powers, never real Phoenician gods. Names draw on the morphs plus Punic divine flavor; no two identical. Neutral/Chaotic.
religion.the_one: Atharon (< Aeternus; God Most High, the distant maker, honored not petitioned)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: each opposing power (the Chaotic 13 for a Lawful-leaning realm; the Lawful 12 for a Chaotic one) keeps its morphed name + a hostile portfolio-epithet, distinct per power: Maraksh the Devourer; Lusanto the Coin-Serpent; Tulrish the Blinding Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Beth (temple) of [power]: 'the Beth of Arganz'.
religion.saints_pattern: deified founder-heroes venerated at the city-tophet; 'the Blessed [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Arganz: scales and a tuna over a coin
holy_symbol_motifs.Rialath: a triangle beneath a disc and crescent

banks_patterns.ships: trade-ship names: 'Bringer of Argaman', 'Wave of Numyo', 'the Crimson Star'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [clan] Sacred Band / the [god] Spears: 'the Sacred Band of Orlanz'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: drowned trade-colonies and tophets: 'the Tophet of Qart-[name]'
